text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A, D and E at gains felt satisfying, but I should base future sells on my investment plan rather than the pleasure of locking in gains or the pain of realizing losses.","Buying all five stocks in Period 4 broadened my holdings, but equal-sized purchases are not automatically good diversification; I should consider each position’s risk and its role in the portfolio.","Most periods passed without trading, and short-term price changes are unpredictable. I should stay patient and avoid trading just because prices have moved."]}
